symptom: A theme's SCSS fails to compile with `Error: Expected expression` pointing at a `$…-scope:` line, and every Go test is green — `mx check` says nothing either, because the failure is in mxbuild's Sass pass, before any model validation
cause: A selector was assigned to a Sass variable bare (`$s: :root` or `$s: a, b`). Neither is a Sass expression; only a **quoted string** is, and `#{}` drops the quotes at the point of use
file: `cmd/mxcli/theme/theme.go` (`expand`, the `{{SCOPE}}` substitution quotes; `{{PALETTE_SCOPE}}` does not, because that file is plain CSS)
insight: **An asset-driven feature whose correctness depends on a compiler the tests never run needs one real compile in the loop.** This shape passed every unit test and broke the build on the first `mxbuild --target=deploy` — the same class as recurring-finding #20. Two placeholders that look interchangeable are not: one lands in plain CSS, one in a Sass expression
